topic: Affect or effect? Grammar in 30 seconds

vars.confession: I mix them up in every essay.
vars.aRule: Affect is the verb: stress can affect your sleep.
vars.bRule: Effect is the noun: the effect of stress is bad sleep.
vars.tip: think RAVEN. Remember, affect is a verb, effect is a noun.

title: Affect or effect? Never mix them up again
